title: Summer school in Cholpon-Ata organised by Vilnius University

blocks.text: From 22 to 30 July 2024, a summer school was held in Cholpon-Ata as part of the GreenKG project “Digital and Green Universities for Sustainable Development of Kyrgyzstan”, supported by the European Union’s Erasmus+ programme. The summer school was organised by Vilnius University under work package 1.
